workload: 24 rounded libadwaita cards with labels, buttons and switches; 240px/s scroll
animation_phase: continuous from first tick; not reset after warmup

frame_observations.scope: before/after-paint callback arrival and GDK backend feedback; not physical scanout
frame_observations.capture: warmup and sample; phase assigned by before-paint arrival; no per-frame output
frame_observations.feedback_read: after sampling stops, without draining pending events; final frames may remain incomplete
frame_observations.zero_timestamps: zero means unavailable, not a measured zero delay
frame_observations.paint_span_scope: callback phase wall time includes update/layout/drawing and any waits; not GPU execution time
frame_observations.gap_scope: time outside observed paint callbacks; does not by itself identify a compositor, scheduler or GPU wait
frame_observations.tick_boundary_scope: legacy tick statistics use smoothed frame timestamps, which may cross the warmup boundary

per_second_scope: nominal 1s timer windows; use actual_elapsed_seconds; a delayed callback is not subdivided
cpu_scope: this process and its threads only; excludes compositor, Xorg, GPU and kernel workers
warmup_scope: includes session check after warmup; shader completion is not observed
session_check_scope: start, end of warmup, and end only
metric: GTK frame-clock tick and monotonic after-paint callback intervals; not scanout/presentation
